title: Siege battles
changes: When a land is under siege and you come near, both clans now send real soldiers to fight at its standards and at the Hold gate.
A front changes hands when one side has more fighters there for a while; the rings show who holds each one and the plaque counts the fronts.
Sworn heroes who stand at a front their clan holds earn it valor every minute, the gate twice as much. Soldiers alone earn nothing.
